Product Owner - Abloxx (XAB) at Teroxx

About us
Teroxx is a digital asset boutique. Abloxx Ltd provides the Abloxx Token (XAB) and ecosystem products such as Rewards, Crypto Grow and Cashback.

Responsibilities
- Drive the complete lifecycle of the XAB token, including its strategic evolution and core infrastructure upgrades.
- Implement and manage complex business logic that governs token utility, VIP eligibility and reward mechanics across user portfolios.
- Build and scale utility features such as trading fee management, reward boosters and VIP tier governance.
- Oversee internal ledger systems, closed-loop token economy mechanics and automated reconciliation processes.
- Translate tokenomic strategies and regulatory constraints (MiCAR) into technical product specifications for Engineering and Design.
- Drive stakeholder alignment across IT, Legal/Compliance, CRM and C-Level leadership.

Requirements
- 3-5 years of Product experience with clear ownership responsibility, ideally within FinTech, digital assets or tokenized ecosystems.
- Proven experience building or owning financial ledgers, digital wallet architectures, or closed-loop reward systems.
- Highly technical, systems-oriented mindset with strong abstract thinking.
- Experience working with Jira and Agile delivery.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Nice to have
- Knowledge of MiCA regulation and KYC/AML processes.
- Experience with user retention and growth strategies.
